about: Stills from Muhteşem Yüzyıl (Tims Productions, 2011-2014) for the private Entrika fan game. Keys are the manual's kind.id ids. Each candidate: file (in this folder, long edge <= 1600 px, JPEG ~80%), size [w,h], source_url (the image), source_page (the gallery it was found in), note (who or what is in frame, plus concerns), focus [x,y] = subject centre as fractions, usable as CSS object-position. First candidate is the pick.

not_covered.amb.*: Ambitions are icon-only by design; no stills.
not_covered.term.hizmet / term.hiyanet: The manual has no card ids for Kader cards, so their art uses the glossary ids.
not_covered.ui.title: Not a manual entity: title-screen key art.

graded: graded/ holds every file (and graded/roster/) with the colour grade baked in at s = 0.15: a warm umber-to-gold tritone mixed at 0.8*s = 12 %. Use these in the game; the originals stay ungraded.
roster: roster/<id>.jpg holds the standard portrait for every person card: 4:5, centred on the face, eye line at 37% from the top, face box 36% of the height (face_share). Where the source is too tight the crop zooms in and face_share is higher. posed = an official promo or cast photo; otherwise a screencap, because no posed photo was found. Kul crops use a face share near 0.28 instead (round 16), so their cards frame head and shoulders like the Character cut-outs.
rights: All stills belong to the producer and broadcasters. Private, non-commercial use among friends only; do not publish the game or these files.

Bölüm (4K)", at 4008.3 s; crop x 443-1363. Kaya Akkaya as Lokman Ağa, Süleyman's door ağa who secretly serves Hürrem (tr.wikipedia character list, episodes 109-139), in a black turban and black kaftan over a brown brocade shirt, before a stone wall, facing the viewer, lips just parted. Identified from the Sultan Süleyman channel's clip "MUSTAFA'M HAKKINDA LOKMAN AĞA'YA VAZİFE VERDİM" (c6oc-enqvTo; the man Süleyman gives the order to, a scene from episode 123 at about 2985 s) and his IMDb headshot. Native HD, but he is moving, so slightly soft. Roster eye line 40 %, so the card uses object-position 50% 26%. The old pick (candidate 2) is probably not Lokman: its IMDb caption names Kaya Akkaya and Selim Bayraktar, and the man on the left (teal turban, earring) matches Selim Bayraktar's Sümbül Ağa; Kaya Akkaya is more likely the man cut off on the right.
Kaya Akkaya as Lokman Ağa (left of frame); cropped out of a two-shot with Sümbül Ağa. Only one tagged still found.

Clip "MUSTAFA'M HAKKINDA LOKMAN AĞA'YA VAZİFE VERDİM" on the show's official Sultan Süleyman character channel (@SultanSuleymanOfficial), the clip that identified Lokman for candidate 1 (episode 123 scene). Kaya Akkaya as Lokman Ağa, black turban and kaftan, head and chest, facing the viewer with eyes lowered, dark room. Sharp and still (candidate 1 is soft from motion), but the face fills about 37 % of the frame height, so a 4:5 roster crop stays tight (about 0.32). No wider shot of him is in this clip. YouTube's own auto-captured frame of the clip (maxres1.jpg, 1280x720, no overlay), fetched with curl from i.ytimg.com; the 1080p player grab is still the better source if the frame is wanted at full size.

comp.ayas.identity: Candidate 1 is Fehmi Karaarslan as Ayas Paşa: the face matches his TMDB headshot (https://www.themoviedb.org/person/2380051-fehmi-karaarslan) and his press photos (tgrthaber.com, 2024), and the same face and costume head the fan compilation "Fehmi Karaarslan - Ayas Paşa - Muhteşem Yüzyıl" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s2M_VpWBnsQ). Wikipedia and IMDb credit him as Ayas Paşa, seasons 1-3. The file's own source page is still unknown.
